description.en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance.
The ID of the backup vault.

title.zh: 查询符合条件的SAP HANA数据库备份参数

descriptions.zh: 若要查询数据库的备份保留时间，可以调用DescribeHanaRetentionSetting。
descriptions.en: If you want to query the backup retention period of a database, you can call the DescribeHanaRetentionSetting operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-hana-backup-setting --vault-id v-000css000000za5uyqr --cluster-id cl-00068btz000000oku --database-name SYSTEMDB --region cn-hangzhou
